import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def grab(tag,h=17,w=17):
    m=re.search(tag+r' \(%dx%d\):\n'%(h,w),t)
    return [[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
I=grab('Demo pair 1 input'); O=grab('Demo pair 1 output')
print(I==O)
for c in range(17):
    iv=[(r,I[r][c]) for r in range(17) if I[r][c]]
    ov=[(r,O[r][c]) for r in range(17) if O[r][c]]
    if iv!=ov: print(c,'in',iv); print(c,'out',ov)

def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if g[h-1][c]==5]
    for c in cols:
        col=[g[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        nz=[r for r in range(h) if col[r]]
        out=[]
        for r in range(h):
            if col[r]: out.append(col[r]); continue
            below=[col[r2] for r2 in nz if r2>r]
            above=[col[r2] for r2 in nz if r2<r]
            out.append(below[0] if below else (above[-1] if above else 0))
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=out[r]
    return g
